People: Jean-Baptiste-Barthélemy Lesseps (author, Wikidata Q727434), died 1834. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Lesseps, Jean-Baptiste-Barthélemy, baron de, 1766-1834") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Travels in Kamtschatka, during the years 1787 and 1788. Translated from the French of M. de Lesseps, ... In two volumes. ...  1790: Vol 1, 1790, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_travels-in-kamtschatka-_lesseps-jean-baptiste-b_1790_1. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 75%, 74%, 50% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Jean-Baptiste-Barthélemy Lesseps, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
